home.tagline: Connecting Farmers, Buyers, and Drivers — Directly
home.heroSubtitle: Fresh farm produce straight from village fields to your doorstep, delivered reliably by local drivers without middlemen.
home.whoAreYou: WHO ARE YOU? — SELECT YOUR ROLE:
home.roleSectionSub: Transparent agricultural marketplace with zero middlemen
home.farmerCardDesc: Sell your produce directly, no middlemen. Set your own fair prices and receive instant direct payments.
home.buyerCardDesc: Buy fresh harvest produce directly from local farms at wholesale rates with guaranteed farm-gate freshness.
home.driverCardDesc: Earn reliable daily income delivering produce from village farms to town markets and customer doorsteps.
home.howItWorksSub: Connecting field, home, and delivery in 3 simple steps
home.step1Desc: Farmers set their available harvest quantity and fair price directly on the platform in seconds.
home.step2Desc: Buyers order farm-fresh produce at transparent rates without paying any middleman commission.
home.step3Desc: Nearby verified drivers pick up the produce straight from the farm gate and deliver it promptly.
home.aboutText: Naam Uzhavar brings together smallholder farmers, conscious consumers, and local goods transport drivers on a unified transparent platform. By eliminating exploitative middlemen, we ensure fair returns for farmers, wholesome produce for consumers, and steady livelihoods for drivers.
